path.data-text: SETUP.EXE, QUILLDOS.EXE, the help, the fonts and
All three, sharing one copy of the common files,
Every disk carries README.TXT and LICENCE.TXT, and is 1.44 MB. On the all-in-one disk
and the CD, Windows 3.x Setup is A:\WIN31\SETUP and Windows 95 Setup is
A:\WIN95\SETUP; A:\SETUP is the DOS one.
The serial is QD01-0010: QD01, then the version 0.1.0 in hexadecimal digits. DIR and VOL
